context: Stacks Definition 12.3.1; no zero object, finite biproduct or all-kernel existence is automatically imposed.
editorial_note: Stacks Definition 12.3.1; no zero object, finite biproduct or all-kernel existence is automatically imposed.
text: A preadditive category C is a category whose hom-set Hom_C(x,y) is an abelian group for every pair of objects, and whose composition is bilinear in its morphism arguments.

context: Stacks Definition 12.3.8; existence of finite products is additional to bilinear hom-set composition, and does not force kernels or cokernels of all arrows.
editorial_note: Stacks Definition 12.3.8; existence of finite products is additional to bilinear hom-set composition, and does not force kernels or cokernels of all arrows.
text: An additive category is a preadditive category with finite products, including an empty product; equivalently it has a zero object and finite direct sums.

context: Stacks Definition 12.5.1; the canonical coimage-to-image isomorphism condition is essential and not a consequence of mere preadditivity or universal kernel/cokernel existence.
editorial_note: Stacks Definition 12.5.1; the canonical coimage-to-image isomorphism condition is essential and not a consequence of mere preadditivity or universal kernel/cokernel existence.
text: An abelian category is an additive category with a kernel and cokernel for every morphism f, such that the canonical comparison morphism Coim(f)→Im(f) is an isomorphism for every f.
